name: delegation
description: Teach the brief a subagent is handed, then gate on it: a spawn without a How-it-fails section is refused (the refusal carries the section to fill in), a builder-class spawn also needs a Spiral bound and this session's pattern-check receipt, an undeliverable message is marked NOT delivered, and a builder report without its Stopped-because line draws a warning. With the eleven general agents and the three direct-work guards ported from newdle.
